references.text: The Israelites were forced into hard labor with clay and bricks in Egypt, a construction method similar to that described in Babel.
Pharaoh refused to give straw for brick production (לְבֵנִים), the same type of building material used at the Tower of Babel.
The Valley of Siddim had asphalt pits (בֶּאֱרֹת חֵמָר), where חֵמָר is the same word for asphalt/bitumen as in the Babel story.
The basket Moses was placed in was sealed with asphalt (חֵמָר), the same material used as mortar in Babel.
Isaiah warns against those who say, 'The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone' - pride in building plans that recalls the ambition of the builders of Babel.
